newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIAN ENERGY FRNS TO BE REGISTERED.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIAN ENERGY FRNS TO BE REGISTERED.

text.p: Lithuania's huge state-run energy company Lithuanian Energy said on Wednesday that a $75 million floating rate note (FRN) will be registered at the Securities Commission on Friday.
"The notes will be registered when the securities commission meets on Friday," a Lithuanian Energy official told Reuters.

The FRN issue is led by investment bank Merrill Lynch and carries a three-year maturity. The official would not say what the rate was but said that it would not exceed the bench mark for Lithuanian state securities.
The official added that most of the notes had already been distributed to investors abroad.
He said that Lithuanian Energy would use the money for working capital.
Lithuanian Energy, like all companies in the energy sector, is caught in a vicious cycle of debt. Consumers, including mant state enerprises, owe it a huge sum of money.
